description: An abstract base class for 'Thing' event implementations within the Eclipse Ditto project, handling event metadata and JSON serialization.

classes.name: AbstractThingEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic 'Thing' event in the Eclipse Ditto framework, encapsulating common event properties such as type, identifier, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata, with JSON serialization support.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated Thing.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the Thing.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the event, if available.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the event, if available.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the event type as its manifest, marked @Nonnull.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JSON object according to the provided schema version and predicate.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to append event-specific data to the JSON payload.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this and another object.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method to assist with equality checks.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the event.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.
